display.title: The Three Weeks: Ahavas Yisroel Will Rebuild the Beis HaMikdash
display.summary_short: Why there is no music in the Three Weeks, why baseless hatred caused the Churban, and why Hashem, like a parent, delights most when His children love one another.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show during the Three Weeks, edited together from the opening and a later part of the same broadcast. Uncle Yossi explains that no music is played in these weeks because they recall the saddest page in Jewish history, the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash. Since it was destroyed because Jews failed to love their fellow as themselves, strengthening Ahavas Yisroel will bring the Geulah. As the month of Av arrives, he asks what caused these tragedies and how to prevent them: our Sages say it was baseless hatred, which Hashem despises. He brings the Alter Rebbe's teaching that just as nothing pleases parents more than seeing their children live in harmony, nothing pleases Hashem more than seeing His children, the Jewish people, love one another. Doing so corrects the mistakes of the past and paves the way for Moshiach, who will bring every Jew home to Eretz Yisroel.
display.lesson: Hashem, like a loving parent, delights most when His children love each other; Ahavas Yisroel will rebuild the Beis HaMikdash.
